nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory family schematic, with primary-supported implementation distinctions. The drawing runs from methylated genomic DNA through extraction, fragmentation (labelled Fractionate), biotinylated-MBD capture on streptavidin magnetic beads, increasing-salt elution and DNA purification to the final DNA icon; the right-edge DNA label is partly clipped. The leftmost nucleosome cartoon is descriptive, without a transfer arrow or a separate assay branch. Library preparation and sequencing are text-supported interfaces, represented below only for the identified MethylCap-Seq, MiGS and MBDCap-Seq implementations. These are alternative method routes from fragmented DNA, never simultaneous inputs or pooled libraries. MBD-Seq and MBDCap remain catalogue group labels whose cited array implementations do not establish the depicted sequencing workflow. No historical priority, universal alias equivalence or cross-method interchangeability is asserted.
